plugins.description: Kaga's master build system for premium client websites. Opus 5.5 leads (GPT-6 Astra only on explicit instruction) a nine-agent crew through Plan, Act, Audit with a human gate. Routes every phase to installed specialist skills, enforces reference fidelity, researched art direction, a resolved image plan, zero defaults, baked-in security, a costed quote, and learns from past builds through a lessons file and a history-mining retro.
